Midpoint Calculator

Find the midpoint of a line segment in 2D or 3D by averaging the coordinates.

(5, 7)
Midpoint

  




  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Choose 2D or 3D.
  2. Enter the two endpoints.
  3. Press Find midpoint to see the result and the averaging steps.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What is the midpoint formula?
Average each coordinate: M = ((x₁+x₂)/2, (y₁+y₂)/2), and likewise for z in 3D.
Is the midpoint always between the points?
Yes — it is the exact center of the segment, equidistant from both endpoints.
Can I use it to bisect repeatedly?
Yes, applying it again to each half quarters the segment — the basis of binary search on a line.
